focus: 區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求~Separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage

units.anchor: 飽和土有效應力~Effective stress in saturated soil
units.title: 飽和土有效應力~Effective stress in saturated soil
units.mechanism: 土骨架承擔的有效應力等於總應力扣除孔壓，地震快速循環可改變孔壓而不立即改變上覆重量。初始狀態必須由地層、地下水與應力歷史共同建立。假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。~Soil-skeleton effective stress is total stress minus pressure. Rapid earthquake cycling can change pressure without immediately changing overburden weight, so initial conditions require stratigraphy, groundwater and stress history. At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination.
units.verify: 以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。~Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.
units.failure: 若把總應力當有效應力，循環需求與抗力修正都可能失真；實際水位較高時初始骨架應力更低，原本看似充足的安全餘裕可能消失。~Using total stress as effective stress distorts demand and resistance corrections. Higher actual groundwater reduces initial skeletal stress and can remove an apparently adequate margin in the original evaluation.
units.misconception: 只要飽和土有效應力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for effective stress in saturated soil removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接飽和土有效應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以單位重積分核對總應力，將地下水位及測點孔壓轉為同一高程。季節或承壓含水層差異須列成情境，不能用單次乾季讀值代表地震設計水位。~When handing over effective stress in saturated soil, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Integrate unit weights for total stress and reconcile water levels and pressures on one datum. Seasonal and confined-aquifer differences need scenarios rather than one dry-season reading representing design groundwater.

units.anchor: 循環應力需求~Cyclic stress demand
units.title: 循環應力需求~Cyclic stress demand
units.mechanism: 簡化循環應力比把地表加速度、應力比與深度折減整合，用於相容方法內的觸發分析。它不是完整時域土體反應，複雜場址與重要構造可能需要更深入分析。假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。~A simplified cyclic stress ratio combines acceleration, stress ratio and depth reduction within a compatible triggering method. It is not a full time-history soil response, and complex sites or important assets may need more detailed analysis. For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless. Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless.
units.verify: 核對地震輸入的基準位置、加速度定義及折減係數來源，將採用的震級與持續時間處理方式寫清楚。場址反應需與所選經驗觸發法一致，避免重複修正。同時排除以下干擾原因：將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。~Check motion reference location, acceleration definition and reduction-factor source, documenting magnitude and duration treatment. Keep site-response assumptions consistent with the empirical triggering method to avoid duplicate corrections. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition.
units.failure: 將基岩加速度直接當地表值或把峰值加速度單位錯用為g，會系統性改變需求；忽略場址放大時，錯誤不會因資料表計算精確而消失。~Substituting bedrock motion for surface motion or confusing acceleration units with g changes demand systematically. Spreadsheet precision cannot correct omitted site amplification or an inconsistent input definition.
units.misconception: 只要循環應力需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for cyclic stress demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接循環應力需求時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對地震輸入的基準位置、加速度定義及折減係數來源，將採用的震級與持續時間處理方式寫清楚。場址反應需與所選經驗觸發法一致，避免重複修正。~When handing over cyclic stress demand, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check motion reference location, acceleration definition and reduction-factor source, documenting magnitude and duration treatment. Keep site-response assumptions consistent with the empirical triggering method to avoid duplicate corrections.

units.anchor: 觸發抗力比值~Triggering resistance ratio
units.title: 觸發抗力比值~Triggering resistance ratio
units.mechanism: 循環抗力與需求必須處於同一震級、應力及修正基準，才可相除成觸發指標。比值超過一仍不直接證明永久位移、局部薄層及整體系統皆可接受。假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。~Cyclic resistance and demand must share magnitude, stress and correction references before division. A ratio above unity does not itself establish acceptable permanent deformation, thin-layer response or system performance. With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold. Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold.
units.verify: 保存貫入試驗原始資料與每項修正，逐層檢查細料、應力及震級基準是否一致。將抗力與需求的不確定性一併審查，由岩土工程師訂定所需可靠度。同時排除以下干擾原因：把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。~Retain penetration data and every correction, checking fines, stress and magnitude conventions by layer. Review demand and resistance uncertainty together, with the geotechnical engineer defining the required reliability. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support.
units.failure: 把不同文獻的修正係數任意混用，可能在無察覺下高估抗力；平均比值大於一也可能掩蓋連續薄弱層，造成側移或地盤支承能力突變。~Mixing corrections from incompatible methods can silently overstate resistance. An average ratio above unity may conceal a continuous weak layer responsible for lateral movement or a sharp loss of support.
units.misconception: 只要觸發抗力比值符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for triggering resistance ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接觸發抗力比值時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。保存貫入試驗原始資料與每項修正，逐層檢查細料、應力及震級基準是否一致。將抗力與需求的不確定性一併審查，由岩土工程師訂定所需可靠度。~When handing over triggering resistance ratio, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain penetration data and every correction, checking fines, stress and magnitude conventions by layer. Review demand and resistance uncertainty together, with the geotechnical engineer defining the required reliability.

units.anchor: 超額孔壓接近極限~High excess pressure ratio
units.title: 超額孔壓接近極限~High excess pressure ratio
units.mechanism: 高超額孔壓比代表初始有效應力大幅耗減，但實際土體應力路徑及循環剪應變仍重要。不能把一個感測點的比值當整場地同時完全液化的證據。假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。~A high excess-pressure ratio indicates substantial loss of initial effective stress, while stress path and cyclic strain remain important. One sensor cannot establish simultaneous full liquefaction across a site. For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress. Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single maximum without waveform review can misrepresent the extent of liquefaction and subsequent deformation demand.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress.
units.verify: 量測孔壓須同步加速度與變形，檢查飽和、零點、動態範圍及位置。比較多深度反應，區別儀器截頂、局部噴砂通道與可代表土層的行為。同時排除以下干擾原因：感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。~Synchronize pressure with acceleration and movement, checking saturation, zero, range and location. Compare depths to distinguish clipping, local vent paths and representative layer response. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single maximum without waveform review can misrepresent the extent of liquefaction and subsequent deformation demand.
units.failure: 感測器量程不足可把更大的反應截成固定值，或漏氣使峰值偏低；只看單點最大比值而不查波形，會錯判液化範圍與後續變形需求。~Insufficient range can clip the response while air leakage can suppress peaks. A single maximum without waveform review can misrepresent the extent of liquefaction and subsequent deformation demand.
units.misconception: 只要超額孔壓接近極限符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for high excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接超額孔壓接近極限時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測孔壓須同步加速度與變形，檢查飽和、零點、動態範圍及位置。比較多深度反應，區別儀器截頂、局部噴砂通道與可代表土層的行為。~When handing over high excess pressure ratio, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Synchronize pressure with acceleration and movement, checking saturation, zero, range and location. Compare depths to distinguish clipping, local vent paths and representative layer response.

units.anchor: 分層震後沉陷~Layered post shaking settlement
units.title: 分層震後沉陷~Layered post shaking settlement
units.mechanism: 震後排水與再密實造成體積變形，沉陷需按層厚與體積應變積分。估計應變應來自合適方法，不能用觸發安全比值直接線性換算地表下沉。假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。~Drainage and reconsolidation after shaking cause volumetric change, requiring integration over layer thickness. Suitable methods establish strains; a triggering factor cannot simply be converted linearly into surface settlement. For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers. Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers.
units.verify: 比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。同時排除以下干擾原因：遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。~Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. Document each layer's strain source, applicable range and uncertainty. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.
units.failure: 遺漏薄但高應變的夾層會低估總沉陷；相同平均沉陷在相鄰位置若分布不同，結構接頭可能已超限，不能只用場地總平均判斷可使用性。~Omitting a thin high-strain lens understates settlement. Spatial variation can exceed joint movement limits even with a moderate site average, so average subsidence alone cannot establish serviceability.
units.misconception: 只要分層震後沉陷符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for layered post shaking settlement removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接分層震後沉陷時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比較震前後水準測量、地下沉陷及地層分布，辨別側移或基礎轉動造成的表觀沉陷。將每層應變來源與適用範圍列入計算書，保留不確定區間。~When handing over layered post shaking settlement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare pre- and post-event levels, subsurface settlement and stratigraphy, distinguishing lateral movement or foundation rotation. Document each layer's strain source, applicable range and uncertainty.

units.anchor: 側向擴展應變~Lateral spreading strain
units.title: 側向擴展應變~Lateral spreading strain
units.mechanism: 液化區鄰近自由面或斜坡可能產生永久側向位移，對埋管及隧道接頭的需求和垂直沉陷不同。平均剪應變只能描述選定帶寬，局部剪切集中還需細化。假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。~Liquefied ground near a free face or slope can move laterally, imposing demands unlike vertical settlement. Mean shear strain describes a selected band width but does not resolve localized shear concentration. For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude. Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude.
units.verify: 用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。把接頭、支承及穿越位置納入協調，由地工和結構工程師共同判定需求。同時排除以下干擾原因：將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。~Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Coordinate joints, supports and crossings so geotechnical and structural engineers jointly establish demand. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.
units.failure: 將位移均勻攤到過長距離會低估局部應變，管線在狹窄剪切帶可先破裂；沒有明顯地表噴砂也不能單獨排除深層側移的影響。~Spreading displacement across too long a distance understates local strain and can miss rupture at a narrow band. Absence of obvious sand boils does not exclude damaging deep lateral movement.
units.misconception: 只要側向擴展應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for lateral spreading strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接側向擴展應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用地表裂縫、測量與地層調查辨識變形帶，沿管線方向分解相對位移。把接頭、支承及穿越位置納入協調，由地工和結構工程師共同判定需求。~When handing over lateral spreading strain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map deformation bands using cracks, surveys and stratigraphy, resolving relative motion along utilities. Coordinate joints, supports and crossings so geotechnical and structural engineers jointly establish demand.

units.anchor: 改善抗力增幅~Treatment resistance gain
units.title: 改善抗力增幅~Treatment resistance gain
units.mechanism: 改良前後循環抗力比較應保持相同應力及震級基準，且考慮土層代表性。抗力增幅不是安全係數增幅，除非同時證明需求、修正及載重狀態均相同。假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。~Compare cyclic resistance before and after treatment on common stress and magnitude references. Resistance gain is not necessarily a safety-factor gain unless demand, corrections and loading also remain unchanged. For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged. New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設相容CRRold=0.30、CRRnew=0.45，抗力比0.45/0.30=1.50；只有CSR相同時觸發比值才同比增加。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For compatible CRRold=0.30 and CRRnew=0.45, resistance gain is1.50. The triggering ratio increases proportionally only if CSR stays unchanged.
units.verify: 配對施工前後地層與試驗位置，保存修正後抗力剖面和新增載重情境。用獨立測試或試區檢查低改良區，避免只選最佳位置代表全區成效。同時排除以下干擾原因：地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。~Match layers and tests before and after work, retaining corrected profiles and new loading scenarios. Independently examine low-gain zones rather than presenting the best location as representative of the whole treatment. Also rule out the following competing explanation: New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation.
units.failure: 地盤加載可能同時改變有效應力與需求，若只看抗力增加就宣稱風險下降，會漏掉新增結構荷載及水位改變造成的不利效果與空間差異。~New loading can change both effective stress and demand. Claiming lower risk from resistance alone overlooks adverse effects of added structure load, changed groundwater and spatial variation.
units.misconception: 只要改善抗力增幅符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for treatment resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接改善抗力增幅時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。配對施工前後地層與試驗位置，保存修正後抗力剖面和新增載重情境。用獨立測試或試區檢查低改良區，避免只選最佳位置代表全區成效。~When handing over treatment resistance gain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Match layers and tests before and after work, retaining corrected profiles and new loading scenarios. Independently examine low-gain zones rather than presenting the best location as representative of the whole treatment.

units.anchor: 樁身震後負摩阻~Post event pile downdrag
units.title: 樁身震後負摩阻~Post event pile downdrag
units.mechanism: 周圍土震後下沉相對於樁身會形成負摩阻，增加樁的軸力需求。簡化沿程均勻剪應力只提供量級，實際中性點、樁土相對位移及荷載轉移需共同分析。假設樁徑D=1m、受負摩阻長L=8m、平均τ=20kPa，Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN，約503kN；不得與同段正摩阻重複計入。同一樁段一面計負摩阻需求一面又計滿額正摩阻抗力會重複使用界面能力；震後樁身軸力可能因此被低估，接頭與樁端更容易過載。~Reconsolidating soil moving down relative to a pile adds downdrag. Uniform interface shear provides a scale estimate, while the neutral plane, relative movement and load transfer require integrated analysis. For D=1m, downdrag length L=8m and mean τ=20kPa, Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN, about503kN. Do not also credit positive friction over that segment. Crediting full positive resistance while assigning downdrag on the same segment double counts interface capacity. This can understate post-event axial force and expose connections or toes to overload.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設樁徑D=1m、受負摩阻長L=8m、平均τ=20kPa，Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN，約503kN；不得與同段正摩阻重複計入。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For D=1m, downdrag length L=8m and mean τ=20kPa, Qdrag=πDLτ=502.7kN, about503kN. Do not also credit positive friction over that segment.
units.verify: 以土層沉陷預估與樁身應變或荷載資料建立相對位移模型，檢查中性點及樁端反應。將震後狀態作獨立荷載組合，由基礎工程師確認容量及服務性。同時排除以下干擾原因：同一樁段一面計負摩阻需求一面又計滿額正摩阻抗力會重複使用界面能力；震後樁身軸力可能因此被低估，接頭與樁端更容易過載。~Combine soil-settlement estimates with pile strain or force evidence to model relative movement, neutral plane and toe response. The foundation engineer checks capacity and serviceability for a distinct post-event load case. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Crediting full positive resistance while assigning downdrag on the same segment double counts interface capacity. This can understate post-event axial force and expose connections or toes to overload.
units.failure: 同一樁段一面計負摩阻需求一面又計滿額正摩阻抗力會重複使用界面能力；震後樁身軸力可能因此被低估，接頭與樁端更容易過載。~Crediting full positive resistance while assigning downdrag on the same segment double counts interface capacity. This can understate post-event axial force and expose connections or toes to overload.
units.misconception: 只要樁身震後負摩阻符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for post event pile downdrag removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接樁身震後負摩阻時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以土層沉陷預估與樁身應變或荷載資料建立相對位移模型，檢查中性點及樁端反應。將震後狀態作獨立荷載組合，由基礎工程師確認容量及服務性。~When handing over post event pile downdrag, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Combine soil-settlement estimates with pile strain or force evidence to model relative movement, neutral plane and toe response. The foundation engineer checks capacity and serviceability for a distinct post-event load case.

units.anchor: 改善範圍證據~Verified improvement coverage
units.title: 改善範圍證據~Verified improvement coverage
units.mechanism: 改良成果需證明空間覆蓋及深度，不只是提交合格試驗的數量。已驗證面積比例適合追蹤資料完整性，未驗證區的位置及連通性仍可能控制整個系統。假設目標面積1000m²、符合既定證據要求900m²，覆蓋率=900/1000=90%；剩餘100m²不因平均比例高而自動合格。未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。~Treatment evidence must establish spatial and depth coverage, not merely count passing tests. A verified-area fraction tracks completeness, while the location and continuity of remaining gaps may control system performance. For a1000m² target and900m² meeting predefined evidence requirements, coverage is90%. The remaining100m² is not automatically acceptable because the overall fraction is high. A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設目標面積1000m²、符合既定證據要求900m²，覆蓋率=900/1000=90%；剩餘100m²不因平均比例高而自動合格。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For a1000m² target and900m² meeting predefined evidence requirements, coverage is90%. The remaining100m² is not automatically acceptable because the overall fraction is high.
units.verify: 將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。依控制破壞機制決定補查位置，主管工程師逐區確認證據充分性。同時排除以下干擾原因：未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。~Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Choose supplementary checks by controlling failure mechanism and have the engineer confirm evidence zone by zone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.
units.failure: 未驗證區若形成跨越基礎的連續帶，即使占比小也可能主導側移；以報告頁數或試驗總數替代空間覆蓋，會造成系統安全的假象。~A small unverified strip crossing the foundation can control lateral deformation. Report length or total test count is not spatial coverage and can create a false impression of system reliability.
units.misconception: 只要改善範圍證據符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for verified improvement coverage removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接改善範圍證據時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將每個測試、施工柱位與深度範圍放入同一地圖，標記未覆蓋的帶狀或角落區。依控制破壞機制決定補查位置，主管工程師逐區確認證據充分性。~When handing over verified improvement coverage, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map tests, treatment locations and depth ranges together, marking unverified strips and corners. Choose supplementary checks by controlling failure mechanism and have the engineer confirm evidence zone by zone.

units.anchor: 需求敏感度與交接~Demand sensitivity and handover
units.title: 需求敏感度與交接~Demand sensitivity and handover
units.mechanism: 觸發判定對需求及抗力都有不確定性，交接應保留情境範圍和最不利位置。兩個需求值的比較只顯示模型敏感度，不代表地震發生機率或永久變形大小。固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。~Both demand and resistance are uncertain, so handover preserves scenario ranges and controlling locations. Comparing two demand values illustrates model sensitivity, not earthquake probability or permanent deformation magnitude. At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio. Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：固定教學CRR=0.40時，CSR=0.30得FS=1.33，CSR=0.40得FS=1.00；需求提高會降低同基準抗力比。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed teaching CRR=0.40, CSR=0.30 gives FS=1.33, while CSR=0.40 gives FS=1.00. Higher demand lowers the consistently referenced ratio.
units.verify: 交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。業主與工程師共同指定監測、震後檢查及重啟條件，避免單一比值取代程序。同時排除以下干擾原因：若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。~Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment. Owner and engineers define monitoring, post-event inspection and reopening conditions rather than replacing procedures with one ratio. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed.
units.failure: 若新增開挖或地下水改變後仍沿用原比值，風險資料會失去時效；只保存合格結論而未保存假設，接手工程師無法辨識哪些條件已經改變。~Later excavation or groundwater changes can invalidate the original ratio. Retaining only a passing conclusion without assumptions prevents the next engineer from identifying which boundary conditions have changed.
units.misconception: 只要需求敏感度與交接符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for demand sensitivity and handover removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接需求敏感度與交接時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。交接輸入地震、水位、試驗修正及改善覆蓋地圖，列明哪些變更需要重新評估。業主與工程師共同指定監測、震後檢查及重啟條件，避免單一比值取代程序。~When handing over demand sensitivity and handover, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Handover motion, groundwater, corrections and coverage maps, identifying changes requiring reassessment. Owner and engineers define monitoring, post-event inspection and reopening conditions rather than replacing procedures with one ratio.

title: 液化地盤評估與改善~Liquefaction assessment and mitigation
summary: 本課聚焦區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。假設總應力150kPa固定，孔壓由100增加10%至110kPa，有效應力由50降至40kPa，降低20%；這展示差值的敏感度，不表示液化機率增加20%，亦未單獨完成抗力與需求評估。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination. At fixed total stress150kPa, increasing assumed pore pressure from100 to110kPa by10% reduces effective stress from50 to40kPa, or20%. This illustrates difference sensitivity, not a20% rise in liquefaction probability or a complete demand-resistance evaluation. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立區分液化觸發、永久變形與改善覆蓋的驗證需求的背景。灣區捷運完成系統耐震脆弱度研究（2002）。美國聯邦公路管理局列出岩土耐震參考手冊（2011）。美國聯邦公路管理局列出地盤改良參考手冊（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for separate liquefaction triggering, permanent deformation and verified treatment coverage. BART completes a system seismic vulnerability study (2002). FHWA lists its seismic geotechnical reference manual (2011). FHWA lists its ground modification reference manual (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設總垂直應力σv=150kPa、孔壓u=100kPa，σ′v=σv−u=50kPa；此為指定深度的初始狀態，不是液化判定。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At a selected depth with σv=150kPa and u=100kPa, σ′v=50kPa. This is an initial state, not a liquefaction determination.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設amax/g=0.30、σv/σ′v=2、rd=0.90，CSR=0.65(amax/g)(σv/σ′v)rd=0.351；各因子都採用無因次比值。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For amax/g=0.30, σv/σ′v=2 and rd=0.90, CSR=0.65×0.30×2×0.90=0.351; all factors are dimensionless.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已相容修正CRR=0.40、CSR=0.351，FS=CRR/CSR=1.14；數值是教學比值，不作現地驗收門檻。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With compatibly corrected CRR=0.40 and CSR=0.351, FS=1.14. This teaching ratio is not a field acceptance threshold.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設初始σ′v0=100kPa、循環增加Δu=95kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.95；若總應力近似固定，殘餘有效應力約5kPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For initial σ′v0=100kPa and cyclic Δu=95kPa, ru=0.95. Approximately fixed total stress leaves about5kPa effective stress.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩層厚H1=3m、H2=4m，震後體積應變εv1=0.02、εv2=0.01，S=Σ εviHi=0.02×3+0.01×4=0.10m。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For H1=3m, H2=4m, εv1=0.02 and εv2=0.01, S=Σ εviHi=0.10m, assuming predominantly vertical, one-dimensional reconsolidation of both layers.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設兩側相對永久位移Δ=0.30m、變形帶寬L=5m，γ≈Δ/L=0.06即6%；這不是由震級直接推算的位移。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For relative permanent movement Δ=0.30m across L=5m, γ≈0.06, or6%. This assumed movement is not derived directly from earthquake magnitude.
